About the Center

A neighborhood clinic,
run like a family practice.

The center opened in 2009 with two consultation rooms and a simple idea: Beirut families shouldn't have to cross the city — or guess the bill — to see a good doctor. Today the center covers eight specialties under one roof, with its own lab and dental unit.

Your file stays with us, your doctor knows your history, and your results reach you the same day. If we can't treat it here, we'll tell you honestly and point you to who can.

  • Prices posted before you book — no surprises at the desk
  • Lab results by WhatsApp, same day for most tests
  • Arabic, English and French spoken at reception

Services & Prices

What we do — and what it costs

All prices in USD, fixed before your visit. If a treatment plan changes mid-way, we re-quote before we continue — never after.

Uninsured? Ask about the family card — 15% off consultations and lab work for the whole household, all year.

Our Doctors

The doctors who'll know your name

A small, stable team — the doctor you see this year is the one who saw you last year.
